svg.aria-label: Agent Hub architecture: your phone, tablet and laptop reach the Hub through a private Tailscale network. The Hub is the router in the middle: it sends work to missions, desktop control and media tools, takes input from talk, hand control and your apps, and is called by saved routines and the schedule.
svg.text: AGENT HUB · runs on your PC
AUTONOMOUS LLM · private copy of your repo
